data.name: Subtitle
data.value: Everything at once — for moving to a new server. An export snapshot secures one project, this archive the whole installation.

data.name: AdminOnly
data.value: An installation backup contains the entire content including the accounts. It is reserved for administrators.

data.name: BackupHint
data.value: The archive contains the normal export ZIP with asset files per project, and next to it everything that appears in no project export.

data.name: ContainsUsers
data.value: Users, roles and API keys (including password hashes)

data.name: ContainsTools
data.value: Boards, whiteboards, change log, recycle bin, views, rules, webhooks

data.name: ContainsNoConnection
data.value: No connection string — it describes the server you are moving away from.

data.name: RestoreWarning
data.value: The entire content of this installation will be replaced. Every existing project automatically gets an export snapshot as a safety net beforehand.

data.name: ConfirmMessage
data.value: All projects, accounts and tool data of this installation will be replaced by the contents of the archive. Your own account too — sign in afterwards with the credentials from the archive.

data.name: RestoreDone
data.value: {0} projects, {1} users, {2} roles and {3} API keys imported.
